title: Simultaneous Merge Strategy
definition: The process of merging multiple adapters onto a fresh base model at low scales to preserve reasoning and add new knowledge.

difficulty_levels.beginner: A method of combining different AI models together, so they work as a single model without losing their original abilities.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: A strategy that ensures a base AI model absorbs new knowledge from multiple adapters, while maintaining its original reasoning capabilities by applying the adapters at a low scale simultaneously.
difficulty_levels.expert: A novel AI workflow that prevents performance degradation by merging multiple adapters onto a fresh base model at low scales, which avoids complex order-dependent merging sequences and catastrophic forgetting.

extra_fields.insight: The fresh base preserves reasoning, while the simultaneous low-scale merge adds knowledge.
